name: tessera
description: Rooms to read in. Sixteen themes for the Claude Code desktop app, each one still while you read.

plugins.name: tessera
plugins.description: Tessera: all 16 themes in one plugin. Type /tessera and a name to change the room.

plugins.name: pluvia
plugins.description: Pluvia (rain). Rain on a window, and a lit city through the glass.

plugins.name: aurora
plugins.description: Aurora (dawn). Northern lights over a snowy ridge on a long polar night.

plugins.name: phosphor
plugins.description: Phosphor (light-bringer). The soft glow of an old green screen, and the paper it printed on.

plugins.name: abyssus
plugins.description: Abyssus (the deep). Deep blue water, with jellyfish glowing softly at the edges.

plugins.name: nox
plugins.description: Nox (night). A clear night sky over low hills, with stars gathered at the edges.

plugins.name: vesper
plugins.description: Vesper (evening). The last light of evening over a wide plain, with a sun half set at the edge.

plugins.name: ignis
plugins.description: Ignis (fire). A hearth at night, with embers glowing low in the corners and sparks rising at the edges.

plugins.name: machina
plugins.description: Machina (machine). An engineer's blueprint, with gears and a compass rose drawn in the corners.

plugins.name: aurum
plugins.description: Aurum (gold). Gold fans and sunbursts in the corners of a warm black room.

plugins.name: silva
plugins.description: Silva (forest). Pine woods in mist, with fireflies at the edges of the trees.

plugins.name: scriptorium
plugins.description: Scriptorium (writing room). A vellum page with painted vines in its margins, and a candle burning low at night.

plugins.name: meridies
plugins.description: Meridies (midday). Sand dunes at noon under a large pale sun.

plugins.name: hortus
plugins.description: Hortus (garden). A greenhouse in soft daylight, with broad leaves reaching in from the edges.

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: Nix (snow). Snow falling quietly past a bare branch, with drifts in the corners.

plugins.name: mare
plugins.description: Mare (sea). A quiet shore seen from above, with foam washing in at the edges.

plugins.name: flos
plugins.description: Flos (flower). A flowering branch in spring, reaching in from the corner.
